title: Horse Armor: Recrafted
description: Adds more crafting recipes for horse armor.
body:
## Horse Armor: Recrafted
Isn't it weird that there is a crafting recipe for leather horse armor, but every other type has to be discovered? Well, this data pack aims to fix that.
### General Information
This mod introduces crafting recipes for every type of horse armor. Currently, it is untested for any version except for 1.21.10, but feel free to test it out with any version you wish.

### Features
- Craftable Copper Horse Armor
- Craftable Iron Horse Armor
- Craftable Golden Horse Armor
- Craftable Diamond Horse Armor

### Upcoming
- Universal version of the Data Pack
- Mod that includes Custom Horse Armor (e.g. Emerald Horse Armor)
- Mod that backports the upcoming Netherite Horse Armor (from Mounts of Mayhem)
